title: Score a line, find its slope, solve for the bottom
brief: Write the squared-miss loss and its gradient, check the gradient against finite differences, and solve the normal equations.
hints: loss: misses = X @ w - y, then 0.5 * np.sum(misses ** 2). Return a float.
gradient: X.T @ (X @ w - y). The result has one entry per weight, so its shape is (d,).
fit_normal_equations: np.linalg.solve(X.T @ X, X.T @ y). Do not invert the matrix.
